name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. '3e' is dispatch index 0x3E into the per-event handler table @ 0x51B91 (xref from table entry @ 0x51C89, bytes 98 58 03 00 = 0x35898), a real domain ID not an address residue. 'ch27' is chapter 27 (valid 1-30 chapter ID), the chapter whose tile-step slot 0 triggers this handler. 'dyn_turn_event' accurately describes the behavior: it arms a dynamic turn-event by writing turn_counter+1 into the turn-event hook table. No address residue in the name.
purpose: Chapter-27 first-time tile-step handler (dispatch idx 0x3E) that arms a dynamic turn-event one player turn ahead of the current battle turn, then consumes its own tile-event slot.
logic_summary: Gated on the first-time flag tile_event_consumed_flags[0x11]: if zero, write (uint8)(battle_turn_counter + 1) into tile_event_data_table[+3] (turn-event hook entry 0's turn byte) to schedule a turn-event one turn ahead, then set tile_event_consumed_flags[0x11] = 1 so it never re-arms. Otherwise no-op. The +1 is computed in 8-bit (MOV DL,[turn_counter]/INC DL/MOV [data_table+3],DL); the (uint8) truncation reproduces that exactly. Stack frame 4 via __CHK; arg unused.

params.name: event_arg
params.semantics: Tile-step ABI dispatch argument (stepping char id). Unused by this handler -- body never reads it (cast to void). Matches the 1-arg cdecl dispatch-table signature.
params.reason: Generic name is appropriate here because the value is unused; consistent with the other unused-arg handlers in this file (event_arg). No address residue.
